limitations: Review was bounded to the supplied snapshot and packet artifacts; Git history and external repository state were not inspected.

All 52 supervisor Python tests passed independently with bytecode generation disabled. Node preflight tests were not replayed because the snapshot intentionally omits installed dependencies; their source and relevant production path were inspected.
Started and completed timestamps are orchestration bounds; the Codex subagent harness did not expose provider wall-clock or token measurements.
